title: draba lactea var. tenuisiliqua
intro: Draba lactea var. tenuisiliqua, commonly known as Alpine Whitlow Grass, is a rare and endangered plant species found in the mountainous regions of China. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Draba lactea var. tenuisiliqua include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic applications and potential health benefits.
